what: Candidate for the temperature preset (D-62, D-69). An absolute scale: 17 classes; class 0 is below -30 C, classes 1 to 15 are 5 C wide from -30 to +45, class 16 is +45 and above. The pale break is at 0 C. Breaks are defined in C and converted exactly for F.

checker.rule: D-88: at least 10 between EVERY pair of classes; full-severity simulation in linear light, 1976 Lab difference, D65
checker.history: As first filed the scale passed for neighbouring classes only; two non-neighbouring warm classes were 7.5 apart under deuteranopia (8.4 at 256). Found by the PLAN red-team. One class was moved in each version.

against_the_dark_ground.note: truecolor against 16,22,28; the 256 figure is against 0,0,0 (it is 13.9 against the truecolor ground) - it passes either way

order.rule: FR-16: relative luminance rises to the break and falls from it - holds at both depths, both grounds

lightness_under_simulated_colour_vision.truecolor: holds under all three kinds, after class 15 was moved from 153,34,51 to 148,29,46 - a difference of 1.9, below what the eye can tell; before it, class 14 to 15 got lighter under protanopia (25.7 then 27.4). Found by red-team round 3. The rendered specimens 21a to 21e use the earlier colour.
lightness_under_simulated_colour_vision.colours_256_palette: does NOT hold: classes 1 to 2 invert under protanopia (43.3, 42.4) and tritanopia (43.7, 42.1), classes 3 to 4 under tritanopia (58.0, 57.9). The palette is too coarse to fix without losing the all-pairs margin.

on_a_light_ground.why: D-91: on a light ground the two bands at freezing of the scale above are 5.0 and 5.5 from the ground (threshold 10). Three bands change - classes 5, 6 and 7; hue stays on its side of freezing.
